Create ONE NEW landscape1536x1024 TRANSPARENT PNG KFB ink monster sheet: EXACTLY SIX UNIQUE ELDERLY/RETIRED GRANDPARENT INK BLOBS in THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. A warm absurd-surreal group of imagined older patients/neighbours, small everyday complaints, individual hobbies, dignity, stubbornness and vitality; not six helpless stereotypes. Two female-read grandmothers and four male-read older actors. No real person likeness.
Both input PNGs STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: first defines whole rounded charcoal-violet ink body, soft rich plasticine and modeled lids; second defines crafted clay wood/cloth/metal props. NEW original actors, not copied reference costumes/faces or successors of a generated sheet.
EVERY actor ONE continuous COMPLETE UPRIGHT FOOTLESS charcoal-black ink splat, subtle deep purple sheen, thick soft asymmetric rounded lobes, huge face directly in goo, two tiny rounded goo hands, a few contained detached ink drops. Age through slightly sagging rounded lobes, gentle modeled folds, heavy lids, short grey/ivory clay hair accents, soft worn clothes; keep rich smooth rounded PLASTICINE. No stone/cracked rock body, dry gritty camouflage, realistic human skin, human torso/legs/feet, severed bust or full clothed human figure. Only short cardigan/shawl/waistcoat/collar scraps covering less than quarter of body; continuous dark ink belly and lower lobes remain visible. No white doctor coats, medical head mirrors or clinical team uniforms.
ALL actual EYES WHITE/IVORY sclera around distinct small RED IRIS and BLACK PUPIL, thick fully purple-black clay lids. Eyes fully visible: no glasses, magnifier, hat brim or trumpet obscures eyes. Six different facial actions/gaze/brow/lid/mouth shapes and postures. Fresh expression choreography, no fixed repeated slot faces. ALL upright, no lying/reclining actor, no ground.
CRITICAL MOUTH ANATOMY: ALL visible teeth must emerge FROM INSIDE dark mouth cavity, attached to UPPER gum/roof and descending downward. Lower lip forms a continuous border BELOW them. NEVER put any tooth on/below/outside the outer lower-lip surface. Closed mouths show NO TEETH. Some actors have closed mouths, others have small open cavities with only UPPER teeth. No tongue visible or hanging outside.

TOP LEFT — MALE-READ GRANDFATHER with hearing difficulty and sharp curiosity. Broad low pear ink blob, one long droopy crown curl, TWO short ivory clay hair tufts at sides, short faded brown waistcoat panel and little checked scarf. Huge unequal white eyes look SIDEWAYS, one brow high and one lowered in suspicious interest; CLOSED asymmetric compressed mouth, no tooth, heavy but continuous lower lip. Holds ONE SHORT curved brass EAR TRUMPET with flared bell beside own side lobe well below actual eyes, other hand hugs ONE small thick WALNUT WALKING STICK with round knob low against belly, not a long pole touching another cell. No extra ear anatomy, human legs or eyeglasses.
TOP MIDDLE — FEMALE-READ KNITTING GRANDMOTHER, stiff little goo hands but formidable determination. Tall thick wavy-edged pear blob, small ivory clay hair BUN on crown and two short side curls, subtle lashes, muted plum shawl over ONE shoulder only, tiny soft wrist wrap. Unequal white eyes focused DOWN, one squinting and one wide, curved uneven brows, small OPEN crooked determined mouth with TWO ivory UPPER TEETH visibly descending inside mouth, entirely ABOVE intact lower lip. Holds ONE compact KNITTING BUNDLE across own belly: two thick short wooden knitting needles in hands, simple rust-red knitted rectangle on them, one cream yarn ball tucked in fold with one short strand. No extra arms or scarves across face.
TOP RIGHT — MALE-READ GARDENING RETIREE, cheerful defiance of a stiff goo flank. Very wide upright bean, THREE fat crown nubs, small battered olive garden cap, short brown shoulder cloth. One small cream supportive fabric PATCH wraps a side lobe low, not human knee/back. Huge white eyes look UP, one brow lifted in delight, broad SKEWED OPEN LAUGH with THREE small irregular UPPER TEETH attached to upper edge, dark cavity below, uninterrupted lower lip beneath. Holds ONE small chipped terracotta POT with a single fat green seedling, and ONE SHORT rounded steel HAND FORK with three blunt prongs. No soil ground, sprawling roots or garden scene.
BOTTOM LEFT — FEMALE-READ WARMTH-LOVING GRANDMOTHER, alert and comfortably opinionated. Compact round dumpling ink body with sagging side lobes, small soft brick-red KNITTED BEANIE, one short grey clay curl and subtle lashes, little cream checked shoulder blanket, not full robe. Relaxed unequal half-lidded WHITE/red/black eyes glance SIDEWAYS, one brow arched knowingly, CLOSED lopsided satisfied smile, no teeth. One hand cradles ONE small ivory TEACUP, other holds ONE squat WOOL-COVERED HOT-WATER BOTTLE low at belly, plain stopper and thick teal knitted cover. No steam cloud, chair or lying pose.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — MALE-READ RETIRED COLLECTOR, close-focus difficulty and exact memories. Tall hooked kidney ink blob with two folded crown lobes, two tiny silver clay moustache tips at mouth sides, short mustard cardigan panel and one tiny bronze clasp, no hat. Very unequal white eyes stare DOWN, one squinting hard and other huge, thoughtful high/low eyebrows, small OPEN tense mouth with ONE small ivory UPPER tooth inside cavity ABOVE continuous lower lip. Holds ONE little brown COLLECTOR ALBUM open across belly, blank cream pages with only three simple colored square stamps without letters/portraits, and ONE SHORT handled MAGNIFYING GLASS held LOW next to album, not over face/eyes. No extra people in album or spectacles on eyes.
BOTTOM RIGHT — MALE-READ DIGNIFIED NAPPER, easily tired but still determined to be on time. Tall top-heavy crooked splat, one long sagging crown lobe, little soft brown NEWSBOY CAP pushed back, tiny faded green neck fold and short grey clay side tufts. Half-lidded unequal WHITE/red/black eyes look UP in sleepy surprise, eyebrows curved in uneven soft arches. A large vertical OPEN YAWN with ONLY TWO small UPPER TEETH clearly joined to upper gum, black-maroon cavity, continuous thick LOWER LIP BELOW opening, NO teeth on outside/below lip, NO tongue. One hand holds ONE chunky round brass POCKET WATCH with short thick chain low at belly; other steadies ONE SHORT curved-handle WOODEN CANE close to own side, not ground-reaching. Fully upright, not slumped lying, no bed/chair.

Composition: six LARGE complete self-contained actors in regular3x2 visual grid, similar substantial BODY HEIGHT across both rows. Whole silhouettes450-465px per512pxlogical cell, generous clear margins and32-40px clear row gaps. Contain all hats/curls/trumpet/canes/knitting/pot/fork/cup/bottle/album/magnifier/watch/droplets inside OWN cell; no touching/overlap across neighbours, clipped details or miniature bottom row. Bodies warm and bouncy despite age, personality/hobbies as visible as ailments. No gridlines, labels, numbers, lettering, floating symbols, background gradient, floor, shadow discs, checkerboard, halo or watermark. True alpha-zero transparent surroundings and opaque figure interiors, clean antialias, soft upper-left studio light only on figures.
